title: The Dance Created for a Small Stage
short_teaser: Choreographers adapt movement to the dimensions, entrances, and sightlines of a particular place.
story: Choreographers adapt movement to the dimensions, entrances, and sightlines of a particular place. Constraint can shape originality instead of merely limiting it. Creativity grows through attention, experimentation, revision, and the courage to make an imperfect beginning. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
